messages:
john_platform: Heads up — proposing a small semantic change to the rerank endpoint: add `per_candidate_ttl` (ms) and an optional `model_hint` string so routing can prefer compatible variants. Planning a PR tomorrow. Thoughts?

maria_prod: Curious — how does ttl affect billing/quotas? if we attach ttl per candidate, do we count tokens differently?

ali_research: Quick idea: score normalization becomes weird if different models have different decay behavior. We should define whether `score` remains opaque or a normalized float.

sam_sre: Two ops notes: 1) we need telemetry for TTL distributions (p50/p95/p99) per-tenant, 2) ensure TTL doesn't increase tail latency if we start fanout with long TTLs.

kevin_ui: From console UX: we shouldn't surface `per_candidate_ttl` as a top-level toggle for most users. Maybe an "advanced routing" panel hidden behind a feature flag.

deb_ops: Also thinking about rollout: default behavior should be backward compatible — if `model_hint` absent, route as today. Feature-flagged rollout and console banner for tenants opting in.

john_platform: Agreed on backward-compat. My minimal schema suggestion (proto-ish):

```json
{
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "c1", "payload": "...", "per_candidate_ttl": 120, "model_hint": "rwd-v2-small" },
    { "id": "c2", "payload": "..." }
  ],
  "scoring_mode": "normalized|raw",
  "fallback_policy": "best-effort|strict"
}
```

maria_prod: fallback_policy needs to be explicit for billing. If we fall back to cheaper model, do we re-charge at original model unit or fallback unit? need docs before we flip.

ali_research: If we add `scoring_mode`, default should be `normalized` to keep thresholds consistent across model variants. But we need a clear definition of normalization (min/max? logistic?).

sam_sre: +1 on telemetry sampling tag: every request that includes `model_hint`/`per_candidate_ttl` should get a routing_tag in logs so we can correlate latency and quota hits. Add a sampling rate param for heavy traffic.

kevin_ui: For console, we can show an aggregated panel: %requests with candidate TTL, per-tenant p95 TTL, and routing fallback counts. Deb, can ops own the dashboard tile?

deb_ops: Yes, ops can own the tile. Will need a small schema for the telemetry: `{metric: "rerank.ttl.p95", tags: [tenant, model_hint], value}`. Also want canary label when rollout is enabled.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by john_platform for branch `rerank/ttl-modelhint` tomorrow 09:30 UTC (canary to 2 tenants).

john_platform: Action items I’ll take: 1) draft PR with proto + migration plan, 2) add feature flag, 3) wire basic telemetry tags, 4) open docs PR for billing semantics. Deb/kevin/maria — can you review the telemetry/dashboard proposal by EOD?

maria_prod: I can review billing text.

kevin_ui: I’ll mock the console tile and share a screenshot. Keep advanced controls behind a toggle.

ali_research: I can write a short note on normalization math we can land as RFC.

sam_sre: I’ll add sampling hooks to the ingest pipeline and run a smoke test on canary.

john_platform: Thanks all — will post PR link once ready. :thumbsup:
